mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GE_MP_JOB_S A WHERE 1 = 1
AND A.PPCD = #{PPCD}
AND A.FRM_CFY = #{FRM_CFY}
AND A.FRM_NM LIKE '%'||#{FRM_NM}||'%'
AND A.WRK_NM LIKE '%'||#{WRK_NM}||'%'
AND A.REGPR_NM LIKE '%'||#{REGPR_NM}||'%'
AND A.MTNG_DY BETWEEN #{MTNG_DY_S} AND #{MTNG_DY_E} ORDER BY MTNG_DY DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GE_MP_JOB_S ( UNQ_KY_VAL, TST_UNQ_KY_VAL, FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL, DIVS_CD, PPCD, FRM_CFY, FRM_NM, PRCDOC_NO, PRCDOC_VER_NO, MTNG_DY, MTNG_HSMPR_ID, MTNG_TITL, MTNG_PLC_NM, WRK_SCTN_NM, WRK_NM, WRK_TRGT_NM, WRKOR_NO, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT, TRSN_YN ) VALUES ( #{UNQ_KY_VAL}, #{TST_UNQ_KY_VAL}, #{FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL}, #{DIVS_CD}, #{PPCD}, #{FRM_CFY}, #{FRM_NM}, #{PRCDOC_NO}, #{PRCDOC_VER_NO}, #{MTNG_DY}, #{MTNG_HSMPR_ID}, #{MTNG_TITL}, #{MTNG_PLC_NM}, #{WRK_SCTN_NM}, #{WRK_NM}, #{WRK_TRGT_NM}, #{WRKOR_NO}, #{REGPR_ID}, #{REGPR_NM}, SYSDATE, 'N' )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM GE_MP_JOB_S WHERE UNQ_KY_VAL IN(${CHK_ITEMS})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GE_MP_JOB_S ( UNQ_KY_VAL, TST_UNQ_KY_VAL, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT ) VALUES ( #{UNQ_KY_VAL}, #{TST_UNQ_KY_VAL}, #{REGPR_ID}, #{REGPR_NM}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT UNQ_KY_VAL, DIVS_CD, PPCD, FRM_CFY, CASE WHEN A.FRM_CFY = 'GEN' THEN '일반작업전회의' WHEN A.FRM_CFY = 'REP' THEN '정비작업전회의' WHEN A.FRM_CFY = 'MAN' THEN '수기등록' ELSE '' END AS FRM_CFY_NM, (SELECT FRM_NM FROM GE_MP_ETCFRM_M WHERE FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = A.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL) AS FRM_NM, PRCDOC_NO, PRCDOC_VER_NO, MTNG_DY, REGEXP_REPLACE(MTNG_DY, '(.{4})(.{2})(.{2})','\1-\2-\3') AS FM_MTNG_DY, MTNG_HSMPR_ID, MTNG_TITL, MTNG_PLC_NM, WRK_SCTN_NM, WRK_NM, WRK_TRGT_NM, WRKOR_NO, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT, TO_CHAR(RG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FM_RG_DT, (SELECT ATFL_GRUP_NM||'/'||ATFL_PHCL_NM||'.'||ATFL_FEXT_NM FROM GE_MP_FILE_S WHERE ATFL_GRUP_NM = 'GE_MP_JOB_S' AND UNQ_NO = A.UNQ_KY_VAL) AS ATFL_PHCL_NM FROM GE_MP_JOB_S A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.UNQ_KY_VAL = #{UNQ_KY_VAL}

SELECT UNQ_KY_VAL, DIVS_CD, PPCD, FRM_CFY, CASE WHEN A.FRM_CFY = 'GEN' THEN '일반작업전회의' WHEN A.FRM_CFY = 'REP' THEN '정비작업전회의' WHEN A.FRM_CFY = 'MAN' THEN '수기등록' ELSE '' END AS FRM_CFY_NM, (SELECT FRM_NM FROM GE_MP_ETCFRM_M WHERE FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = A.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL) AS FRM_NM, (SELECT T3.PRCDOC_NO FROM GE_MP_CHECK_S T1, GE_MP_FRM_M T2, GE_MP_PRCDOC_M T3 WHERE T1.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = T2.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL AND T2.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL = T3.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL AND T1.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL = A.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL) AS PRCDOC_NO, (SELECT T3.PRCDOC_RVSN_NO FROM GE_MP_CHECK_S T1, GE_MP_FRM_M T2, GE_MP_PRCDOC_M T3 WHERE T1.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = T2.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL AND T2.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL = T3.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL AND T1.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL = A.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL) AS PRCDOC_RVSN_NO, PRCDOC_VER_NO AS HOGI, MTNG_DY, REGEXP_REPLACE(MTNG_DY, '(.{4})(.{2})(.{2})','\1-\2-\3') AS FM_MTNG_DY, MTNG_HSMPR_ID, MTNG_TITL, MTNG_PLC_NM, WRK_SCTN_NM, WRK_NM, WRK_TRGT_NM, WRKOR_NO, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT, TO_CHAR(RG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FM_RG_DT, (SELECT ATFL_GRUP_NM||'/'||ATFL_PHCL_NM||'.'||ATFL_FEXT_NM FROM GE_MP_FILE_S WHERE ATFL_GRUP_NM = 'GE_MP_JOB_S' AND UNQ_NO = A.UNQ_KY_VAL) AS ATFL_PHCL_NM FROM GE_MP_JOB_S A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL = #{TST_UNQ_KY_VAL}
mapper.update: UPDATE GE_MP_JOB_S SET PRCDOC_NO = #{PRCDOC_NO}, PRCDOC_VER_NO = #{PRCDOC_VER_NO}, MTNG_DY = #{MTNG_DY}, MTNG_HSMPR_ID = #{MTNG_HSMPR_ID}, MTNG_TITL = #{MTNG_TITL}, MTNG_PLC_NM = #{MTNG_PLC_NM}, WRK_SCTN_NM = #{WRK_SCTN_NM}, WRK_NM = #{WRK_NM}, WRK_TRGT_NM = #{WRK_TRGT_NM}, WRKOR_NO = #{WRKOR_NO}, REGPR_ID = #{REGPR_ID}, REGPR_NM = #{REGPR_NM}, RG_DT = SYSDATE WHERE UNQ_KY_VAL = #{UNQ_KY_VAL}
